title: Change password
purpose: Replace the password for your signed-in account.

sections.title: Page variants
paragraphs: For a signed-in user changing their own password. Accounts without a usable password are redirected to Set Password. This is not the administrator form for another user’s password.

items.label: Current Password
items.description: Required existing password for this signed-in account.

items.label: New Password
items.description: Required new password, at least eight characters; account-similarity, common-password and numeric-only checks apply.

items.label: New Password (again)
items.description: Required identical repeat of the new password.

items.label: Change Password
items.description: Saves after validation, preserves this browser’s signed-in session and returns to Change Password with a success message. Other sessions using the old password hash cease to authenticate. Laboratory roles, client ownership and release permissions are unchanged.

items.label: Forgot your password?
items.description: Opens the email recovery form under Current Password.

items.label: Account navigation
items.description: Uses the staff or client shell. Change password and Two-factor authentication open their respective settings; Sign out posts immediate sign-out.

sections.title: Limits
paragraphs: Changing your password does not reset an enrolled authenticator or recovery codes. The committed configuration does not send security-notification emails for password changes. No password-value audit record is created by these self-service pages; administrator changes of another user’s password use the separately audited maintenance form.
